messages.特殊弾丸「灼熱推進弾」で火傷と振動を重ね、S3で振動爆発を重ねる親指の人格。味方: A Thumb Identity that applies Burn and Tremor through special Scorch Propellant Ammo, then triggers repeated Tremor Bursts with S3. He can also replenish allies' ammunition.
messages.灼熱推進弾(15): S3「推力集中」のコインで消耗する。消耗した数だけ次のター: **Scorch Propellant Ammo (15)**: Spent by the Coins of S3 Thruster Compression. Grants Damage Up next turn equal to the amount spent, up to 3. Without ammo, the attack is not cancelled, but that Coin's Burn infliction and Burn Count increase do not activate.
messages.火傷と振動: 各スキルは対象の火傷と振動の合計で威力が上がる。S2「親指へ尊重を: **Burn and Tremor**: Each skill gains power from the target's combined Burn and Tremor. S2 Respect the Thumb. triggers Tremor Burst if the target has at least 6 Tremor.
messages.S3: 灼熱推進弾を3つ以上持っていれば基本威力・ダメージ量が上がり、破壊不能コ: **S3**: With 3 or more Scorch Propellant Ammo, Base Power and damage rise and its Coins become Unbreakable. It converts into Tremor - Scorch, and Coin Ⅲ triggers Tremor Burst up to 3 times.
messages.弾丸の補給: バトルパッシブ「弾丸上納」(傲慢×3・共鳴・同期化Ⅱで取得)により: **Resupplying ammo**: Through the combat passive Ammunition Tribute (3 Pride Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ), the 1 ally earliest in team order among those who use ammo, if they have less than half their ammo after attacking, is resupplied by spending his Scorch Propellant Ammo (once per battle; 1 more is supplied to higher-ranking Thumb Identities).
messages.S1・S2で振動を積み(火傷は他の味方かS3で補う)、灼熱推進弾が3つ以上あるう: Stack Tremor with S1 and S2 (cover Burn with other allies or S3), and layer Tremor Bursts with S3 while he still has 3 or more Scorch Propellant Ammo. Paired with allies who use ammo (especially Thumb Identities), he also acts as a resupplier. The value of a single round differs by Identity, so place a high-value ammo Identity (such as Meursault's The Thumb East Capo IIII) earliest in team order among the ammo users.
